🎬 MAKE AN ANIMATION! 🎬
Create your own cartoons

✏️ ANIMATE

Drag joints to pose your stickman, then add frames
Movement between frames is filled in smoothly for you
Onion skin shows your last pose so everything lines up
Draw by hand, create shapes and animate the camera

⚔️ FILL YOUR SCENE

50+ characters: ninjas, knights, robots, ghosts and more
150+ props, weapons, animals and  effects
Give a character a sword and it moves with their hand!
27 backgrounds plus music and sound effects


🏆 EARN & UNLOCK

Weekly contests with star prizes
Daily challenges and a free daily gift
Open crates for rare and Legendary characters
Get VIP for exclusive characters, scenes and effects

👍 Like and favourite for updates!
